liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): The twenty-minute Good Lovin' is noted as one of the most unusual performances [14]
- **Deal** (1 review): Jerry Garcia lets loose during the transition from Deal to the final Not Fade Away [7]
- **Truckin** (1 review): The band gets tangled up in each other during the middle jam of Truckin' [15]

## The recordings

- **gd72-04-16.sbd.miller.18103.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 4.29/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: A slight hiss is present throughout the recording, though it remains bearable [7]
- **gd1972-04-16.sbd.schnell-sweeney-cotsman.10528.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 125 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording requires decent subwoofers and high volume to mask the tape hiss [14]
- **gd72-04-16.sbd.pset1.hanno.19861.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 58 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1972-04-16.pset2-sbd.vernon.9196.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 52 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- The show took place in a low-ceilinged Aarhus University cafeteria with people hanging from rafters [9]
- The band felt comfortable performing in the low ceilinged university cafeteria [16]
- The performance is considered the best Truckin' from the entire tour [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-04-16.sbd.miller.18103.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MR>?>C>Sound Forge>SHN [1]. Also: Set two is described as a very clean lineage compared to the incomplete first set [9]
- **gd1972-04-16.sbd.schnell-sweeney-cotsman.10528.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by J. Cotsman; source: SBD > Master Reel [2]. Also: Source one is a degraded SBD with frequent cuts and occasional tape warble [2]
- **gd1972-04-16.pset2-sbd.vernon.9196.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD>MR>??>CDR [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Exclusive April 11, 1972 Download](https://www.dead.net/features/exclusive-april-11-1972-download) [18]
